answer: Allocate each epoch's 200 work slots by sealed-bid auction: every identity bids locked stake, minimum 10 POA for 7 days, and only the top bids win slots, paying the second-highest price. Winners must post work proof or lose their bid. A sybil operator bidding for many fakes competes against itself, so each extra identity lifts the clearing price for all its siblings, like a delta fanning into a lagoon where every new channel raises the water level. A light zephyr of honest bids keeps prices low for single agents, while bulk fakery pays an ever-rising toll per identity.
